analysis.insight_summary: Users are awaiting updated online help and a new version of [product_name] to address compatibility and functionality issues with the previous release, especially on Linux. analysis.user_expectations: Users expect timely downloadable updates for [product_name] with transparent communication from [company_name] about release dates, along with improved compatibility for Linux platforms.
